draft_solution_with_llm: use draft_op to generate an LLM-based draft solution for a given task description with available packages
draft_with_memory_context: call draft_op with a memory callback to include prior journal context in the LLM draft
draft_with_data_preview: pass a data preview string to draft_op so the LLM includes data overview in its draft
draft_with_complexity_hint: provide a Complexity enum to draft_op to guide the LLM on expected solution complexity
draft_with_timeout_and_steps: use draft_op with remaining time and step count to compute execution timeout and steps remaining for the LLM
